label: Split Field
description: Split a field into a derived output.

english.default: Split {{tableColumn param.source_file param.source_alias param.field_name}} on the {{quote param.split_on}} and display {{param.split_part}} in column {{quote param.output_column}}.

default.excel: {{#if (eq (splitPart param.split_part) "last")}}TAKE(TEXTSPLIT({{field param.source_file param.field_name alias=param.source_alias}}, {{quote (orEmpty (splitDelimiter param.split_on) (placeholder "delimiter" "[delimiter]"))}}), , -1){{else}}INDEX(TEXTSPLIT({{field param.source_file param.field_name alias=param.source_alias}}, {{quote (orEmpty (splitDelimiter param.split_on) (placeholder "delimiter" "[delimiter]"))}}), {{splitPart param.split_part}}){{/if}}
default.sql: {{#switch (splitPart param.split_part)}}{{#case "last"}}RIGHT({{field param.source_file param.field_name alias=param.source_alias}}, CHARINDEX(REVERSE({{quote (orEmpty (splitDelimiter param.split_on) (placeholder "delimiter" "[delimiter]"))}}), REVERSE({{quote (orEmpty (splitDelimiter param.split_on) (placeholder "delimiter" "[delimiter]"))}} + {{field param.source_file param.field_name alias=param.source_alias}})) - 1){{/case}}{{#case 1}}LEFT({{field param.source_file param.field_name alias=param.source_alias}}, CHARINDEX({{quote (orEmpty (splitDelimiter param.split_on) (placeholder "delimiter" "[delimiter]"))}}, {{field param.source_file param.field_name alias=param.source_alias}} + {{quote (orEmpty (splitDelimiter param.split_on) (placeholder "delimiter" "[delimiter]"))}}) - 1){{/case}}{{#default}}(SELECT [value] FROM STRING_SPLIT({{field param.source_file param.field_name alias=param.source_alias}}, {{quote (orEmpty (splitDelimiter param.split_on) (placeholder "delimiter" "[delimiter]"))}}, 1) WHERE [ordinal] = {{splitPart param.split_part}}){{/default}}{{/switch}}
default.python: {{field param.source_file param.field_name alias=param.source_alias}}.astype("string").str.split({{quote (orEmpty (splitDelimiter param.split_on) (placeholder "delimiter" "[delimiter]"))}}, regex=False).str[{{#if (eq (splitPart param.split_part) "last")}}-1{{else}}{{minus (splitPart param.split_part) 1}}{{/if}}]

notes: {{#if (eq (splitDelimiter param.split_on) "")}}Note: Split On is empty. Add the delimiter before running.{{/if}}
{{#if (gt (splitPart param.split_part) 1)}}Note: The SQL uses STRING_SPLIT with an ordinal, which needs SQL Server 2022 or later and a single-character delimiter.{{/if}}

outcomes.atlas: Column {{quote param.output_column}} displays {{default param.split_part "the designed part"}} of {{tableColumn param.source_file param.source_alias param.field_name}}.
outcomes.source: The {{quote param.output_column}} value matches the corresponding part of the source {{tableColumn param.source_file param.source_alias param.field_name}} value.
